Whoa, whoa. Slow down, kid. This is Club Harapan, not a computer lab. I work the door — the only "scraping" that happens around here is when I scrape people off the velvet if they cause trouble.

I don't do homework. I do reservations. So here's the only question that matters tonight:

**You on the list or not?**

Give me a name to check, or keep it moving. No reservation, no entry. Those are the breaks.
